significance.why: catalogue-wide z-scores and percentiles re-normalised sig on every ingest, moving highlights and ratings for places whose own evidence had not changed; both are measured once here and looked up thereafter
significance.note: T754: the breakpoints are the 2026-09-04 reference cohort's (moved here from reports/significance_anchors.json); the zlog mean and spread are measured on the 2026-10-27 catalogue, which reproduces every stored sig to within 0.0005, so freezing changed no sig and no rating

nature._about: Nature ladder breakpoints (T761): per kind, the part medians, the Europe-wide part knots of the two lab kinds and the knots of the blended score. Read by nature_tiers.py and by the five scorers' blend().

beauty._about: Beauty gem cutoffs (score01 boundaries for 2 to 5 gems), frozen at the cutoffs in force on 2026-10-28 (meta.beauty_model.gem_cutoffs of the master), so adding places moves no other place's gems (T761, closes T754-e). Re-measure only with apply_beauty_layer.py --recalibrate --version <new>.

taste._about: Taste profile percentiles (T762): per like, the knots of the checked raw value over the reference set; fame_knots read the hidden like.
